notes:
What's new in 0.22.0

• Live TV: Left goes back to your last channel; type a channel number to jump to it; OK while watching opens a channel list with what's on now and next; the guide previews the channel you rest on.
• Hold the OK button on a channel to add it to Favourites — it now works on every remote.
• Sports remembers which channels show a match until it's over.
• Easier-to-read highlights: no more white text on white.
• Zylo opens with the top bar selected, and the featured titles change every launch (and every 4 hours).
• Pick for Me now in Anime too.
